info.title: Sentinel — Integrated Video Management & Analytics Platform
info.description: Camera registry, ANPR sightings, watchlist alerts and route reconstruction over the sandbox camera grid.

get.description: Open endpoint — no auth (docs/api.md §7 open paths).
Dashboard header counts.
List cameras with optional department/health/tier/text filters.

post.description: Manual camera onboarding (Model 1 deliverable); 409 on a duplicate id.

get.description: Coverage gap analysis: offline/degraded cameras, isolated coverage, department summary (Model 1 deliverable).

post.description: Bulk CSV onboarding: per-row accepted/rejected with reasons; one transaction, no partial commit (Model 1 deliverable).

get.description: One camera, full record.

patch.description: Edit camera metadata, ROI, zones, health or tier.

get.description: The playable HLS URL for this session — always the backend relay path, never an upstream URL.

Search sightings with filters; paginated, newest first; ``total``
is computed with the same WHERE as the rows (B11).
The watchlist, highest severity first.

schema.title: Response List Watchlist Api Watchlist Get

post.description:
Add a plate to the watchlist (normalised and canonical-folded at the
boundary); 409 when it is already listed. Evaluator or admin (F41).

delete.description:
Remove a watchlist entry; 404 when it does not exist. Evaluator or
admin (F41: watchlist add and remove).

get.description: Recent alerts (both kinds), newest first.

schema.title: Response List Alerts Api Alerts Get

post.description:
Acknowledge an alert (by its ``alert_id``, or the numeric
``alert_seq``), persisting who acknowledged it. Evaluator or admin
(F41: acknowledge).

get.description:
SSE — live alert push (both kinds, one table, one tailer).

Alerts fire in the worker process, so this tails the ``alerts`` table
(never an in-process bus, F27). The session cookie is accepted here
because ``EventSource`` cannot send headers.

200.description: Server-sent alert events; frames carry id: <alert_seq> and Last-Event-ID replays the gap.

get.description: Zone and object events, newest first.

schema.title: Response List Events Api Events Get

get.description:
Per-camera object/zone event counts over the last *minutes* of the
recording timeline (event timestamps live on that shared timeline, so
the window is anchored at the newest event, not the wall clock).

The worker supervisor's last stats snapshot (data/worker_stats.json):
sustained fps, skip rate, detections/min, per-camera counters.

200.description: The rendered report (HTML page or CSV export)

get.description:
Route report export for one plate — the scored reconstruction as a
printable page or CSV, stops carrying provenance and clock source.

200.description: The rendered report (HTML page or CSV export)

get.description:
The printable gap-analysis report (Model 1 deliverable), regenerated
from the registry on every request so it is never stale.

A live playlist for the wall: the worker's local tee when fresh
(< 20 s), else an RTSP camera's stale tee (never the CDN), else a
sliding window over the CDN recording at the shared-timeline position.

Proxy the AES-128 key named by the upstream playlist, with the
backend's CDN session; refused unless it is a 16-byte key from inside
the CDN origin. Never cached.

Proxy one media segment — **only** a name present in the fetched
upstream playlist, resolved **only** inside the configured CDN origin
(B11). Relay only; nothing is written to disk.
One segment of the worker's local live window (the RTSP tee).

post.description:
Sign in with a username and password; sets the ``sentinel_session``
cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure when SENTINEL_PUBLIC_HOST is
set). Throttled: 5 failures per username or address lock logins for
15 minutes (the lock survives a restart). Audited on success and
failure — the audit row never carries the password.
Revoke the current session server-side and clear the cookie; audited.

get.description:
The signed-in username, role and session expiry (what the UI renders
its menu from). Key-authenticated callers get their role with a null
username and expiry.
List accounts (names, roles, status — never password material).

schema.title: Response List Users Api Users Get

post.description: Create an account; 409 on a duplicate username.

patch.description:
Change role, active flag or password. Disabling an account or
changing its password revokes its open sessions.

delete.description: Delete an account and its sessions.

post.description: Validate an API key and set the sentinel_key cookie (GET-only transport for crops, HLS and the alert stream).

delete.description:
Clear the sentinel_key cookie (authenticated — F41 leaves only /,
/assets/*, /api/health and /api/auth/login open).

get.description: Serve a plate/vehicle crop (auth: header, or the session cookie on GET).

WorkersOut.title: WorkersOut
WorkersOut.description:
The supervisor's stats snapshot (data/worker_stats.json), or
``available: false`` when no worker has written one yet.
